questions.stem_text:
Which of the examples below has not been developed by the European Court of Human Rights
as a situation where the state has a positive obligation to protect?

options.A: When the applicant is in the custody of the state
options.B: Where the state must investigate claims against it
options.C: The development of a legal framework to protect those within the state
options.D: To provide housing for all those homeless within a state

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - To provide housing for all those homeless within a state

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following arguments against the 'fair play' argument in support of a duty to
obey the law is the most persuasive?

options.B: The legal system is, in fact, unfair.
options.D: The law is irrational and ambiguous.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - The legal system is, in fact, unfair.

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following quotations best describes the central thesis of difference
feminism?

options.A: There are fundamental differences between individual women.'
options.B: Men and women have different conceptions of the feminist project.'
options.C: Women look to context, whereas men appeal to neutral, abstract notions of justice.'
options.D: Men are unable to comprehend their differences from women.'

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Women look to context, whereas men appeal to neutral, abstract notions of justice.'

questions.stem_text: What does Dworkin mean by the 'semantic sting'?

options.A: The language of the law is generally unclear.
options.C: Judges are prey to linguistic misunderstanding.
options.D: The rule of recognition cannot fully account for legal validity.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - The rule of recognition cannot fully account for legal validity.
